effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] If there are 2 or more digivolution cards under this Digimon, this Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ Then, place 1 Digimon card with ＜Save＞ in its text from your trash under 1 of your Tamers.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has ＜Save＞ in its text, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
